usefulness.rationale: The dossier contains no content — only identity anchors are provided. A reader learns only the barest facts: name, birth year/place, the Special Envoy role with dates, association with the Svalbard Global Seed Vault and Crop Trust, and 2024 World Food Prize. There is no narrative of what he actually did, no career history, and no retained sources to verify anything. Understanding is minimal but non-zero thanks to the anchors. Remaining questions: the dossier says nothing at all, so it doesn't imply completeness, but it also never acknowledges gaps explicitly. Conversation readiness is poor — a reader could confirm his current/former title and laureate status but could not prepare substantively for a meeting. The three pre-flagged unjustified conclusions (vault-builder, agronomist-training, play-count-as-influence) cannot be matched to any dossier statement because no dossier statements exist; no overclaims can be located without cited text.
